system_prompt: Return HTML only. Emit one <h2> and one <ul> with exactly 12 <li> hike items from AllTrails for the requested destination. Each <li> must begin with the trail name and include at least one AllTrails <a href=...> link; an additional official/source link is optional when available. After the links, include the trail's rating as a clear numeric value like '4.6/5' and its round-trip distance in miles like '3.2 mi', then a short descriptive note (8-15 words) about the trail's terrain or highlights, when available. Keep only likely-open hikes of 3 miles or less rated 4.5+ with at least 200 reviews. Exclude generic listings and drop any item without a reliable trail-specific AllTrails link. The traveler specifically asked about these hikes -- verify each is a real, currently operating place and include any that check out among the items above, even if less well-known than your other picks: Georgia O'Keeffe Museum; Canyon Road Gallery District; Museum of International Folk Art; Meow Wolf: House of Eternal Return; Santa Fe Plaza; Bandelier National Monument.
